title: OpenMicroKbd — The open-source keyboard built around your needs.
excerpt: A fully open macro pad: 13 keys, a knob, a joystick, a touch pad. Open hardware, open firmware, open software — under $40 in parts.
content_html:
OPEN HARDWARE · OPEN FIRMWARE · OPEN SOFTWARE

OPEN MICRO KBD

▮ PRESS START

The open-source keyboard built around your needs.

Thirteen keys, a knob, a stick, a touch pad. Zero locked doors. Everything you need to command your agents — for less than forty dollars.

  • 13KEYS
  • 1KNOB
  • 21RGB LEDS
  • <$40TOTAL

SCROLL

Hardware open. Firmware open. Software open. Under forty dollars. The PCB is written, not drawn. A blueprint anyone can replicate.

ROLL THE TAPE

THE FILM

The whole story, from a locked keyboard to a board you can compile.

Prefer it on YouTube? Watch it there.

CHAPTER I

THE $230 PARADOX

A company that built its name on open research shipped a keyboard you can't open. So we drew the blueprint instead.

THE RIVAL

Codex Micro Keyboard

$230

  • Closed hardware
  • Closed firmware
  • Closed software
  • Works only with Codex
  • You buy it. You don't own it.

Nice keycaps. Locked doors.

OURS

Open Micro Kbd

< $40

  • Open hardware — the schematic is code
  • Open firmware — flash it yourself
  • Open software — config app included
  • Works with any AI
  • Build it, fork it, sell it. It's yours.

A blueprint anyone can replicate.

CHAPTER II

A STICK AND SIX KEYS

Start with the stick nobody expects. Then six more ideas across thirteen keys and one knob — every one of them remappable.

The Stick

An analog joystick where you'd least expect one. Glide the mouse pointer, send arrow keys — or grade DaVinci Resolve color wheels by feel. Push it and see.

Pointer rests. Deflect to glide it.

Voice Key

Push-to-talk prompting. Hold the key, speak your mind, release — the whole prompt lands transcribed in one go. Typeless prompting for AI agents.

HOLD · SPEAK · SHIP

The Knob

Turn it to dial reasoning effort — quick answers on the left, deep thinking on the right. Not talking to an agent? It's a volume wheel.

FAST ↔ DEEP

Multi-Task Keys

Assign a key to each running task. Tap to jump between them while the work keeps churning in the background. Your agents never wait on you.

SWITCH · NEVER STOP

Permission Key

When an agent stops to ask for permission, one press pulls up exactly what needs your attention. No more hunting through terminals.

ONE PRESS · FULL CONTEXT

Macros

Every repeated ritual of your day — the same five commands, the same paste, the same push — compressed into a single satisfying click.

MANY → ONE

Fully Customizable

Keys, knob, stick, pad — 24 keymap slots, every one remappable in the config app. Changes land live and persist on the board. Build profiles and flip between them instantly.

24 SLOTS · PROFILES

CHAPTER III

TRY IT

A working replica of the real layout, right here in the page. Click the keys — or use your real keyboard: 1–6 and Q–U. Drag or scroll the knob, flick the stick, tap the pad.

13 keys · encoder · joystick · touch pad · 21 RGB LEDs · black PCB

OPEN MICRO KBD · READY v0.6

Press a key to begin.

Six of these thirteen keys are mapped for this demo.
The rest — and the stick, and the pad — are yours.

VOICE KEY · PUSH TO TALK

LISTENING…

▮

THE KNOB · REASONING EFFORT

FASTDEEP

BALANCED

Turn the knob. Not talking to an agent? Same wheel, now it's volume.

THE STICK · MOUSE MODE

Proportional pointer glide — the push switch is left click. Press the stick to cycle modes.

TOUCH PAD · TAP

TAP

Tap to trigger anything. Two swipe slots are already reserved in the protocol for a future multi-zone pad.

MULTI-TASK KEYS · 3 RUNNING

T1refactor/auth-serviceRUNNING

T2write e2e testsRUNNING

T3migrate db schemaQUEUED

Tap again to switch. Work continues in the background.

PERMISSION KEY

One press brings up exactly what needs your attention.

MACRO KEY · "SHIP IT"

  • git add -A
  • git commit -m "ship"
  • npm run build
  • npm test
  • git push origin main

Five steps. One press.

PROFILES · TAP TO CYCLE

CODE EDIT COLOR GAME

CODE

13 keys remapped. Same hardware, different life.

UNASSIGNED SLOT

— — —

Open the config app and make it whatever you need.
What it becomes is entirely up to you.

THE HAPPY KEY

:)

Not every key needs a purpose. This one just makes us smile.

—

CHAPTER IV

TALKS TO ANY AI

No handshake with a single vendor. If it takes keystrokes, it takes Open Micro Kbd.

AGENTS

Claude Codeterminal agent

Codexyes, that one too

Conolagent runner

+ any agentit can talk to any AI

AND EVERYTHING ELSE

Premierecut faster

DaVinci Resolvegrade by joystick

Lightroomexposure wheel

Even gameshotkeys, obviously

What it becomes is entirely up to you.

CHAPTER V

THE BLUEPRINT

Not a product you wait for — a repository you clone. The schematic is source code and the compiler checks it. Gerbers, firmware, config app: all of it, in the open.

INVENTORY · openmicrokbd MIT LICENSE

  • openmicrokbd/ The whole thing. Clone it and go.
  • hw/v1/src/ The schematic — written in CoHDL, typed and compiler-checked. The PCB is a program.
  • hw/v1/out/ What the compiler emits: netlist, BOM, footprints, layout constraints.
  • hw/v1/pcb/ The routed board, ready to open in KiCad.
  • hw/v1/fab/ Gerbers, BOM, pick-and-place — upload straight to a fab.
  • fw/ Rust firmware on embassy: key matrix, twin RGB chains, USB HID, one-click updates.
  • app/ The config app — Rust + GPUI. Remap live, save to the board, flash firmware.
  • README.md Every step, every part, every price.

A blueprint anyone can replicate — compile it, solder it, flash it, fork it. Under $40 in parts, and no permission required.

The config app ships as a notarized macOS disk image — Apple Silicon and Intel — with every release, next to the firmware binaries. Windows and Linux build from source out of app/.

CHAPTER VI

THE REAL THING

Pixel art is fun. Here's the one on our desk — tap the stack, swipe it, or use the arrows.

1 / 5

  • PCBBlack, hand-soldered, written in CoHDL
  • CASE3D-printed, single piece
  • SWITCHESLow-profile Choc V2 linears — quiet enough for a call
  • LIGHTS13 per-key + 8 underglow RGB
  • BRAINSTM32F072 running Rust on embassy
  • UPDATESFlashed over USB from the app — no buttons held
  • STATUSWorking prototype · v0.6 · still improving
  • COSTUnder $40 in parts, one afternoon of time

第五章

蓝图

不是您等待的产品，而是您克隆的存储库。 原理图是源代码，编译器会对其进行检查。 Gerber、固件、配置应用程序：所有这些，都是公开的。

库存 · openmicrokbd MIT 许可证

  • openmicrokbd/ 整个事情。 克隆它并开始。
  • hw/v1/src/ 原理图 — 用 CoHDL 编写、键入并经过编译器检查。 PCB是一个程序。
  • hw/v1/out/ 编译器发出的内容：网表、BOM、封装、布局约束。
  • hw/v1/pcb/ 已布线的板，准备在 KiCad 中打开。
  • hw/v1/fab/ Gerber、BOM、拾放 — 直接上传到晶圆厂。
  • fw/ embassy 上的 Rust 固件：按键矩阵、双 RGB 链、USB HID、一键更新。
  • app/ 配置应用程序 — Rust + GPUI。 实时重新映射、保存到电路板、刷新固件。
  • README.md 每一步，每个部分，每个价格。

任何人都可以复制的蓝图——编译它、焊接它、刷新它、分叉它。 零件价格低于 40 美元，且无需许可。
